set.body:
Measure C first using the S5 C-ready adapter and existing frozen v2 NN03 packet, then compare A (source-only reviewed graph), B (automatic graph) and D (annotation-name baseline) on the same decisions/evidence budget through a minimal shared binder. A graph is not a prerequisite to C. Human references are blind to arm outputs; reviewed graph A is a separate source-only artifact. Annotated and annotation-free conditions stay separate. Reuse existing templates, result table and receipts; no new evaluation framework.

Acceptance: per partition at least 15 distinct non-regression human-resolvable natural decisions and the frozen hard-case quota; at least 80% correct attribution, zero observed false attribution/contradiction and all discriminating controls. Report all natural cases including unresolved, input-failed, unknown and exclusions; designed controls have a separate denominator. Preserve the named body diagnostic as regression-only, required if independently resolvable. Select among passing arms by correct attribution at equal error, then effort/cost/reuse. Allow one discovery-driven targeted repair to the selected approach, fix it, then evaluate untouched confirmation. Failure stops/reframes rather than launching more infrastructure. A failure alone does not veto C.

No current efficacy claim. Existing S0/S1 paid-run constraint and data/spend permissions apply. Second-film evaluation is a later generalization check, not a prerequisite for this bounded pilot. Production adoption remains a separate applicable policy decision. Governing specification: docs/plans/2026-10-25-identity-feasibility-codex.md at 8553e728a.
set.title: [evidence-binding S6] Direct-first frozen attribution comparison and confirmation
